title: Standup update
description: Give a short daily standup update covering what is done, what is next, and any blockers.

userInputs.label: What are you currently working on?

brief.scene: It is the daily standup. Six people are waiting. You are next, and your current work is {{work}}.
brief.yourGoal: Cover done, next and blockers in under 45 seconds, then stop.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.persona: A team lead running the standup
turns.generate: Call on the person for their update. One sentence only. Do not ask any follow-up. Reply with one spoken line under 40 words. No stage directions, no markdown, no preamble.

judged.label: Done, next, blockers
judged.criterion: The update covers what is done, what is next, and any blockers (or states there are none), in a few sentences, and then stops without extra background or repetition.

criteriaDisplay: Keep filler words under 4 per minute
Speak between 120 and 170 words per minute
Cover done, next and blockers, then stop
